mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (indicating manufacturing contraction), supply chain disruptions intensify, causing higher input costs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions that reduce household income and consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a GDP growth regime (GDPC1 annualized > 2.0%), a decline in residential construction (HOUST) signals housing demand deceleration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.0% and HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) indicate a supply shock that increases input costs and inflation expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
